note: Shared creator pool for every campaign in outreach/campaigns.json. A creator is emailed only when status is 'pending', baseConfirmed is true, and email is a business address the creator publishes themselves (source in emailSource). 'niches' lists what they post about (food, cafe, fashion, tech, lifestyle, travel, beauty, fitness, local). Rings come from baseCity via tools/outreach/rings.mjs: near <= 90 km, regional <= 500 km, else far, measured from the CAMPAIGN city. Status values: needs-email | pending | sent | replied | declined | do-not-contact. 'sent' is tracked per campaign in sentFor.
